changes.title: Zoo bigger
items: Zoo islands are bigger and closer together, with narrower streets between them
The zoo's floor inscriptions lie flat on the flagstones and read clearly, with wider letters spaced apart

changes.title: Mangrove areas
items: The otter's stream is now a mangrove channel: drowned willows, young mangroves and alders along a brackish channel, reeds and seedlings in the soft grey mud
The heron's heronry is now a mangrove heronry: tall mangroves, drowned larches and old elms round its still mere, nests in their crowns

changes.title: Jungle areas
items: The snake's Norway is now a jungle understory: mossy ironwoods, vinewoods and bamboo among limes and hazels, ferns and flowering shrubs in the leaf litter
The bat's cave mouth is now a jungle cave: old strangler figs, kapoks and yews over the rock walls, ferns between the stalagmites
